text:
maria: quick kickoff  Microseries: 3 short tutorials (local dev, Docker flow, deploy to Dedicated) + one concise benchmark post + a 30-min launch webinar. objective: get devs hands-on within 45m. want a small repo + 1-click deploy. who takes what?

lee: i can own the repo + sample app. plan: tiny Node backend + static frontend; route calls to a pinned model; include a GIF + a playground deploy button. will add CI so master always builds.

drew: i'll draft the benchmark narrative. thinking: use a realistic SaaS chat workload, compare: hosted vs dedicated vs quantized small model. metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, tokens/sec. will write scripts for reproducibility.

anya: i'll own the landing + webinar UX. proposal: gated webinar RSVP but repo open; capture email at RSVP and send follow-up drip. need hero copy and 2 headline variants for A/B.

oliver: i'll do tracking & lead routing. request: standard field set (email, company, role, interest). i'll push HubSpot mapping + UTMs. anyone want special tags?

maria: keep the repo public; gated RSVP is fine. marketing wants some lead gating but we still send direct repo CTA in email.

lee: repo layout suggestion:
- /microseries-llm
  - /1-local-dev
  - /2-docker-flow
  - /3-deploy-dedicated
  - /bench (scripts + sample data)
README: quickstart + expected results + how to run bench.

drew: benchmark plan (short):
1) dataset (200 short chat turns)
2) models: open baseline, quantized variant, dedicated instance
3) runs: 5 x cold starts, 20 x simulated short sessions
4) outputs: table + small graph + reproducible script
will PR to /bench by Wed EOD.

anya: hero copy ideas (pick one):
- "Microseries: Build & ship an LLM demo in under an hour"
- "Hands-on LLM tutorials + real benchmarks  See what's fast and cheap"
(which do we prefer?)

omaria: (typo, ignore)
\oliver: sample inbound payload for HubSpot bridge:
```
POST /api/lead-capture
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "alex@example.com",
  "name": "Alex Example",
  "company": "Acme Corp",
  "role": "Platform Engineer",
  "source": "microseries_landing",
  "utm_campaign": "microseries_launch_apr",
  "interests": ["starter_tutorials", "dedicated"]
}
```
I'll map utm_campaign -> lifecycle_stage and tag with interest arrays.

tracking-bot: scheduled: social teaser post queued for 2024-04-18T15:00:00Z.

lee: gif plan: record a short flow showing prompt -> streaming reply -> latency overlay. i'll export 10s mp4 and a 3s looped gif. need art for thumbnail from design by Tue.

drew: will include quantization notes and a short appendix on tradeoffs. also include command lines we used so people can reproduce.

anya: funnel flow: landing -> RSVP modal (email) -> immediate thank-you email with repo link -> 3-email drip: tutorial highlight, bench deep dive, webinar reminder. CRM tag = microseries_2024_apr.

oliver: recommend UTMs: utm_source=social, utm_medium=tweet, utm_campaign=microseries_apr. will include hidden fields in form.

maria: timeline suggestion:
- Mon: repo skeleton + hero copy (lee + anya)
- Tue: bench harness PR (drew) + gif draft (lee)
- Wed: landing + tracking live (anya + oliver)
- Thu: publish tutorial 1 + teaser posts (marketing)
- Fri: webinar + benchmark post live

anya: can we push webinar to next week if bench needs extra time? open to sliding.

maria: flexible, prefer sooner but can shift. final ask: each owner drop a one-line status in the Notion checklist by EOD. i'll run a 15-min check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT. thanks :raised_hands:
